text:
nina: FYI opened a compact proposal + SDK change to emit a tiny advisory header for client-side metering. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1507. wanted to get platform/console alignment before merging.

parth: quick ask: what exactly goes in the header and what semantics should the ingestion pipeline assume? last time we had mismatched expectations.

nina: header `X-RW-Client-Meter: 1` indicates intent to opt-in. optional meta header `X-RW-Client-Units: <int>` for per-request estimated units. both advisory only; server quota engine unchanged. SDK default = off; opt-in via constructor flag `clientMetering: { enabled: true, sampleRate: 0.02 }`.

eyal: agree advisory only. for ingestion we should record three fields: `client_metered` boolean, `client_units` int (nullable), and `metering_schema_v` string. please avoid making `client_units` affect server-side aggregates by default.

zoe: UX: keep the existing "Consumed units" chart as the canonical view. add an optional overlay called "Client estimates (opt-in)". overlay should be off by default. also add a small adoption tile: percent requests with header.

parth: backfill/migration question: when client headers first appear dashboards might look inconsistent. propose backfill window: for 14 days after rollout, ingestion can assign `client_units=1` for missing headers for SDK versions known to support the header, but this must be feature-flag gated per-org.

nina: +1 on gated backfill. PR adds a migration flag `enable_client_metering_backfill` default false. ops can flip for specific orgs. we'll also add a `metering_migration_note` to the console changelog.

eyal: technical detail: ingestion should tag raw events with `metering_schema_v` and index `units_client_est` in the route index. downstream dashboards must explicitly choose between `units_server` and `units_client_est` when computing aggregates to avoid double-counting. add metric names `units.server` and `units.client_est` to be explicit.

zoe: tooltip language for overlay: "Client-reported estimates are advisory and may differ from server-enforced quotas. Use as a guide, not an enforcement metric." will draft copy.

parth: rollout plan: do not bake canary percentages into SDKs. we'll perform server-side canary assignment and set `client_metered: true` in ingester only when org in canary. SDKs should only indicate intent via header; ingestion attaches canary tag.

nina: SDK will not carry any canary header. SDK will include logging `logger.debug('client-meter: emitted', { units })` when header is sent. added unit tests + a small e2e that runs against local ingest proxy.

eyal: add an audit log line in ingestion when a record is backfilled so we can trace changes: `ingest.audit('client_meter_backfill', { event_id, org })`. ops wants this before we turn on backfill.

zoe: design ask: show a gentle notice on the dashboard (beta ribbon) while overlay adoption < 25% to reduce confusion. also add a FAQ link.

parth: docs: add explicit sentence in "Quotas & billing" that server-side quota counts are authoritative and client units are advisory. also provide guidance for customers that want to build client-side estimators.

nina: one more compatibility callout: some serverless runtimes serialize the client config; we must ensure the default is OFF so we don't accidentally start sending headers in cold-started functions. added note to README.

eyal: ingestion change checklist: 1) schema change to accept `client_units` and `metering_schema_v`; 2) index `units_client_est` in route store; 3) add backfill job behind feature-flag; 4) emit audit logs for backfill. I'll own the pipeline work.

zoe: console work: 1) add overlay toggle in chart settings, 2) add adoption tile, 3) show beta ribbon until adoption threshold, 4) add tooltip & FAQ link. I'll own the UI PR.

ingest-bot: CI: sdk unit tests passed, integration flaky timeout retried, succeeded. PR 1507 merged to main.

parth: schedule: SDK minor release (non-breaking opt-in) tomorrow; ingestion schema + toggle next week; dashboard overlay + tile following week. backfill remains off until explicit ops enablement.

nina: tagging follow-ups: @eyal (ingest mapping + audit logs), @zoe (dashboard UX + beta ribbon), @parth (ops canary list + feature flag), @ingest-bot (CI monitoring).

eyal: thanks all. will open the ingestion PR with schema docs and backfill runbook.

zoe: will draft the tooltip + adoption tile mock and share in next standup.

nina: thanks, closing loop.
